name: Journey Pan Scroll
description: Full-screen scroll story where a fixed photo panel pans, zooms and rotates along SVG motion paths as chapter captions snap past on scroll.
contents: Fixed rounded image panel with vignette
Snap-scrolling chapters, each with a mono eyebrow and a serif title
behavior: Scrolling scrubs a GSAP timeline that moves a focal point along each path segment
Camera follows the focal point with eased pan while scale and rotation change per segment
Chapters scroll inside their own snapping container
editableByProps: Image, chapter text and number of chapters
Camera path, zoom and rotation per segment
Colors, panel radius, vignette, fonts and follow easing

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the panel size or position
needsCodeEdit.where: The svg element className with left-[25%] and w-1/2
The main element className with scroll-snap-type

fixed: Pathsegments count should match chapters minus one for even pacing
Hides the page scrollbar through an html scrollbar-width rule while mounted
Image panel is fixed to the viewport and the component fills the viewport, so it should be the only full-screen section
Loads Instrument Serif and Space Mono from Google Fonts
